user.title: Add a station
user.description: Pick which departure board on mittog.dk you want: the S-tog board or the regional/long-distance train board (Tog). Big stations such as København H have both.

data_description.service: S-tog = Copenhagen S-trains (lines A, B, Bx, C, E, F, H). Tog = DSB regional, InterCity, Øresundståg, Lokaltog, Arriva, etc.

station.title: Choose station
station.description: Type the station name, or part of it (e.g. "Nørre"). You can also type the station code from the mittog.dk address, e.g. VNG from mittog.dk/da/departures/VNG/stog/.

data_description.query: If several stations match, you get to pick one on the next page.

direction.title: Direction and filters for {station}
direction.description: {count} departures are on the board right now. Leave everything empty to see all departures. Pick one or more stations under **Towards** to only keep trains that stop there, e.g. towards København H. Add the same station again later to track the other direction separately.

data_description.towards: Only show trains that call at one of these stations after this one. Empty = both directions.
data_description.lines: Only these lines (S-tog: A, B, C …) or train types (Re, IC, ICL …). Empty = all.
data_description.tracks: Comma-separated track numbers, e.g. 1, 2. Empty = all.
data_description.max_departures: How many upcoming departures are kept in the departures attribute.
data_description.delay_threshold: The disruption sensor turns on when a shown departure is this late (or cancelled).
data_description.hide_cancelled: Leave cancelled trains out entirely instead of flagging them.

error.unknown_station: Unknown station. Pick one from the list.
error.towards_self: A station cannot be its own direction.
error.no_match: No station on this board matches. Check the spelling, or try the other board (S-tog / Tog).

abort.already_configured_hub: Mittog is already set up. Add more stations with the **Add station** button on the Mittog integration page.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Mittog is already set up. Add more stations with the **Add station** button on the Mittog integration page.
